hook: Mirror mein driver missing tha, yaar!
feedback: Great cold open and strong visual descriptions with the blue moonlight and salt flats. However, the emotional bond with the mother feels a bit rushed in just one line; give Dev a bit more vulnerability before the lift scene. The pacing in the middle cuts is solid, but make sure the silent cuts (Cuts 7 and 8) land effectively with eerie sound design cues in production.
lines: Mirror mein driver missing tha, yaar!
Raat ke dhai baje, Kutch road sunsaan thi.
Maa ko phone karke bola, 'Main aa raha hoon'.
Tabhi ek purana truck ruka, driver ne lift di.
Aage dekhte rehna, peeche mat dekhna.
Phone par flash hua ek ajeeb alert.
Driver toh saalon pehle mar chuka tha!
Dev ne darr kar side mirror mein dekha.
Maine kaha tha na... peeche mat dekhna.
Bhatakti aatma ke saath phans gaya tha Dev.
Agar aisi raat ko lift mile, toh sochna mat.
Kya pata agla musafir aap khud ho.
